package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"sort"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Immutable result identity excludes observation time, trigger and retry state.
func HybridConsequenceID(sid, pid, ref, policy string) string {
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte("planner-hybrid-consequence.v1\x00"+sid+"\x00"+pid+"\x00"+ref+"\x00"+policy)).String()
}

// Normalize on owned copies: the existing policy/graph normalizers sort slices.
func NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(policy PolicyBundle, graph HybridPrerequisiteGraph) (HybridConsequenceInputs, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(policy)
	if err != nil {
		return HybridConsequenceInputs{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var owned PolicyBundle
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &owned) != nil {
		return HybridConsequenceInputs{}, ErrValidation
	}
	owned, err = NormalizePolicyBundle(owned)
	if err != nil || math.IsNaN(owned.MasterySkipConfidence) || math.IsInf(owned.MasterySkipConfidence, 0) {
		return HybridConsequenceInputs{}, ErrValidation
	}
	for i := range owned.PedagogyStrategies {
		var config map[string]any
		if json.Unmarshal(owned.PedagogyStrategies[i].Config, &config) != nil {
			return HybridConsequenceInputs{}, ErrValidation
		}
		owned.PedagogyStrategies[i].Config, _ = json.Marshal(config)
	}
	graph, err = normalizeHybridPrerequisiteGraph(graph)
	if err != nil {
		return HybridConsequenceInputs{}, err
	}
	hash, err := hybridSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema string
		Policy PolicyBundle
		Graph  HybridPrerequisiteGraph
	}{"planner-hybrid-inputs.v1", owned, graph})
	return HybridConsequenceInputs{Policy: owned, Graph: graph, InputHash: hash}, err
}

func ProjectHybridPrerequisiteGraph(graph GoalGraph) (HybridPrerequisiteGraph, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(graph)
	if err != nil {
		return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var owned GoalGraph
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &owned) != nil {
		return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, ErrValidation
	}
	owned, err = NormalizeGoalGraph(owned)
	if err != nil {
		return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, err
	}
	out := HybridPrerequisiteGraph{Available: true, GoalCode: owned.Goal.Code, GoalVersion: owned.Goal.Version, GraphVersion: owned.Goal.GraphVersion, Targets: []HybridPrerequisiteTarget{}}
	convert := func(r TargetRef) HybridTargetRef {
		return HybridTargetRef{Type: r.Type, Key: r.Key, Version: r.Version}
	}
	for _, t := range owned.Targets {
		row := HybridPrerequisiteTarget{Ref: convert(t.Ref), Prerequisites: []HybridTargetRef{}}
		for _, p := range t.Prerequisites {
			row.Prerequisites = append(row.Prerequisites, convert(p))
		}
		out.Targets = append(out.Targets, row)
	}
	return normalizeHybridPrerequisiteGraph(out)
}

func normalizeHybridPrerequisiteGraph(g HybridPrerequisiteGraph) (HybridPrerequisiteGraph, error) {
	if !g.Available {
		if (g.GoalCode != "" && !hybridCode(g.GoalCode)) || g.GoalVersion != "" || g.GraphVersion != "" || len(g.Targets) != 0 {
			return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		g.Targets = []HybridPrerequisiteTarget{}
		return g, nil
	}
	if !hybridCode(g.GoalCode) || !hybridCode(g.GoalVersion) || !hybridCode(g.GraphVersion) || len(g.Targets) < 1 || len(g.Targets) > 500 {
		return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, ErrValidation
	}
	owned := make([]HybridPrerequisiteTarget, 0, len(g.Targets))
	byID := map[string][]HybridTargetRef{}
	for _, t := range g.Targets {
		k := hybridTargetIdentity(t.Ref)
		if !hybridTargetValid(t.Ref) || t.Ref.Version == "" {
			return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, ok := byID[k]; ok {
			return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		refs, err := normalizeHybridTargets(t.Prerequisites)
		if err != nil || len(refs) != len(t.Prerequisites) {
			return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, ErrValidation
		}
		owned = append(owned, HybridPrerequisiteTarget{Ref: t.Ref, Prerequisites: sortHybridTargetRefs(refs)})
		byID[k] = refs
	}
	states := map[string]int{}
	var visit func(string) error
	visit = func(k string) error {
		if states[k] == 1 {
			return ErrGoalGraphInvalid
		}
		if states[k] == 2 {
			return nil
		}
		refs, ok := byID[k]
		if !ok {
			return ErrGoalGraphInvalid
		}
		states[k] = 1
		for _, p := range refs {
			if err := visit(hybridTargetIdentity(p)); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		states[k] = 2
		return nil
	}
	for k := range byID {
		if err := visit(k); err != nil {
			return HybridPrerequisiteGraph{}, err
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(owned, func(i, j int) bool { return hybridTargetIdentity(owned[i].Ref) < hybridTargetIdentity(owned[j].Ref) })
	g.Targets = owned
	return g, nil
}

func hybridCode(v string) bool { return v != "" && len(v) <= 128 && v == normalizeCode(v) }
func normalizeHybridScope(s HybridScopeIdentity) (HybridScopeIdentity, error) {
	if !hybridCode(s.GoalCode) || !hybridCode(s.DirectionCode) || s.DesiredStacks == nil || len(s.DesiredStacks) > 100 {
		return HybridScopeIdentity{}, ErrValidation
	}
	s.DesiredStacks = append([]string{}, s.DesiredStacks...)
	sort.Strings(s.DesiredStacks)
	for i, v := range s.DesiredStacks {
		if !hybridCode(v) || (i > 0 && v == s.DesiredStacks[i-1]) {
			return HybridScopeIdentity{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return s, nil
}

var hybridReasons = map[string]bool{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE": true, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY": true, "UNSTABLE_MASTERY": true, "CONFIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT": true, "TARGET_MASTERED_STABLE": true, "NO_RELEVANT_FUTURE_ITEMS": true, "EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP": true, "EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT": true, "REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT": true}
var hybridIntentKinds = map[string]bool{"CHANGE_GOAL": true, "CHANGE_DIRECTION": true, "CHANGE_TRACK": true, "CHANGE_TECH_STACK": true, "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE": true, "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY": true, "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY": true, "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT": true}

func validateHybridMutation(m HybridFutureMutation) error {
	if !hybridUUID(m.ItemID) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	switch m.Kind {
	case "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM", "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT":
		if m.TargetPosition != nil || m.TemplateItemID != "" || m.NewItemID != "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS":
		if m.TargetPosition == nil || *m.TargetPosition < 0 || *m.TargetPosition > 499 || m.TemplateItemID != "" || m.NewItemID != "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM", "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY":
		if !hybridUUID(m.TemplateItemID) || m.NewItemID != "" || m.TargetPosition != nil || m.TemplateItemID == m.ItemID {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION":
		if !hybridUUID(m.TemplateItemID) || !hybridUUID(m.NewItemID) || m.TargetPosition == nil || *m.TargetPosition < 0 || *m.TargetPosition > 499 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateHybridLearningIntentProjection(p HybridLearningIntentProjection, s HybridPlanningSnapshot) error {
	if !hybridUUID(p.IntentID) || p.StudentID != s.StudentID || p.LearningPathID != s.LearningPathID || p.ExpectedPathRevision != s.Path.Version || p.CreatedAt.IsZero() || !hybridIntentKinds[p.Kind] || p.RequestedChange.Mutations == nil || len(p.RequestedChange.Mutations) > 500 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := normalizeHybridScope(p.RequestedChange.Scope)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(normalized, p.RequestedChange.Scope) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range p.RequestedChange.Mutations {
		if validateHybridMutation(m) != nil || seen[m.ItemID] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		seen[m.ItemID] = true
	}
	return nil
}

// The evaluator cannot fetch observations, consent, execute operations or alter
// Student. Every future target must belong to this one coherent snapshot.
func EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s HybridPlanningSnapshot, inputs HybridConsequenceInputs) (HybridConsequence, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(inputs.Policy, inputs.Graph)
	if err != nil || inputs.InputHash != normalized.InputHash {
		return HybridConsequence{}, ErrValidation
	}
	inputs = normalized
	req := HybridSnapshotRequest{Targets: s.RequestedTargets, TriggerContext: s.TriggerContext}
	if ValidateHybridPlanningSnapshot(s, s.StudentID, s.LearningPathID, req) != nil {
		return HybridConsequence{}, ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	byTarget := map[string]HybridSnapshotMastery{}
	for _, m := range s.Mastery {
		byTarget[hybridTargetIdentity(m.Target)] = m
	}
	for _, target := range HybridSnapshotTargets(s) {
		if _, ok := byTarget[hybridTargetIdentity(target)]; !ok {
			return HybridConsequence{}, ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	}
	baseline, err := normalizeHybridScope(HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: s.Profile.DesiredStacks})
	if err != nil {
		return HybridConsequence{}, err
	}
	c := HybridConsequence{Schema: HybridConsequenceSchema, ConsequenceID: HybridConsequenceID(s.StudentID, s.LearningPathID, s.References.SnapshotRef, HybridReplanPolicyVersion), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, SnapshotRef: s.References.SnapshotRef, SnapshotTargets: sortHybridTargetRefs(s.RequestedTargets), PolicyVersion: HybridReplanPolicyVersion, PolicyInputHash: inputs.InputHash, Outcome: HybridOutcomeNoChange, BaselineScope: baseline, DesiredScope: baseline, ReasonCodes: []string{}, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{}}
	reasons := map[string]bool{}
	if s.PendingIntent != nil {
		p := *s.PendingIntent
		if ValidateHybridLearningIntentProjection(p, s) != nil || validateHybridRequestedChange(s, p, inputs, byTarget) != nil {
			return HybridConsequence{}, ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		c.DesiredScope, _ = normalizeHybridScope(p.RequestedChange.Scope)
		c.Mutations = cloneHybridMutations(p.RequestedChange.Mutations)
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(c.DesiredScope, c.BaselineScope) || len(c.Mutations) > 0 {
			c.Outcome = HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded
			c.ApplicationMode = HybridApplicationRequiresIntent
			c.IntentID = p.IntentID
			c.RequiredIntentKind = p.Kind
			reasons["EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT"] = true
			reasons["REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT"] = true
			for _, mutation := range c.Mutations {
				if mutation.Kind == "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION" {
					reasons["EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP"] = true
				}
			}
		} else {
			reasons["NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"] = true
		}
	} else {
		protected := hybridProtectedItems(s)
		mutable := []HybridSnapshotItem{}
		skipped := map[string]bool{}
		for _, item := range s.Path.Items {
			if s.Path.Status != "ACTIVE" || protected[item.ID] || item.Status != LearningPathItemPlanned || len(item.Targets) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			mutable = append(mutable, item)
			positive := true
			for _, target := range item.Targets {
				m := byTarget[hybridTargetIdentity(target)]
				signal := DeriveHybridSnapshotTargetSignal(s, m)
				if signal.Quality != HybridQualityExecution && signal.Quality != HybridQualityProject {
					positive = false
					reasons["INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY"] = true
				}
				if signal.Stability != HybridStabilityStable {
					positive = false
					reasons["UNSTABLE_MASTERY"] = true
				}
				if m.Confidence < inputs.Policy.MasterySkipConfidence {
					positive = false
					reasons["CONFIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT"] = true
				}
				if m.State != MasteryMastered {
					positive = false
				}
			}
			if positive {
				c.Mutations = append(c.Mutations, HybridFutureMutation{Kind: "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM", ItemID: item.ID})
				skipped[item.ID] = true
				reasons["TARGET_MASTERED_STABLE"] = true
			}
		}
		if len(mutable) == 0 {
			reasons["NO_RELEVANT_FUTURE_ITEMS"] = true
		}
		reorder := hybridGapReorder(s, inputs, byTarget, mutable, skipped)
		if len(reorder) > 0 {
			c.Mutations = append(c.Mutations, reorder...)
			reasons["EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP"] = true
		}
		if len(c.Mutations) > 0 {
			c.Outcome = HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded
			c.ApplicationMode = HybridApplicationAuto
		} else {
			reasons["NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"] = true
		}
	}
	for reason := range reasons {
		c.ReasonCodes = append(c.ReasonCodes, reason)
	}
	sort.Strings(c.ReasonCodes)
	sort.Slice(c.Mutations, func(i, j int) bool {
		if c.Mutations[i].ItemID != c.Mutations[j].ItemID {
			return c.Mutations[i].ItemID < c.Mutations[j].ItemID
		}
		return c.Mutations[i].Kind < c.Mutations[j].Kind
	})
	if err := ValidateHybridConsequence(c); err != nil {
		return HybridConsequence{}, err
	}
	return c, nil
}

func cloneHybridMutations(in []HybridFutureMutation) []HybridFutureMutation {
	out := append([]HybridFutureMutation{}, in...)
	for i := range out {
		if out[i].TargetPosition != nil {
			v := *out[i].TargetPosition
			out[i].TargetPosition = &v
		}
	}
	return out
}
func hybridProtectedItems(s HybridPlanningSnapshot) map[string]bool {
	protected := map[string]bool{}
	boundary := -1
	for _, i := range s.Path.Items {
		if i.Status == LearningPathItemReady || i.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
			if i.Position > boundary {
				boundary = i.Position
			}
		}
	}
	for _, i := range s.Path.Items {
		if i.Status != LearningPathItemPlanned || i.Position <= boundary {
			protected[i.ID] = true
		}
	}
	for _, b := range s.CourseBindings {
		if b.LifecycleStatus == "OPEN" {
			protected[b.LearningPathItemID] = true
		}
	}
	for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if b.LifecycleStatus == "OPEN" || b.LifecycleStatus == "RESERVED" {
			if b.LearningPathItemID != "" {
				protected[b.LearningPathItemID] = true
			} else {
				for _, i := range s.Path.Items {
					if i.ReferenceType == "practice" && i.ReferenceID == b.TaskRevisionID {
						protected[i.ID] = true
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return protected
}

// Reorder only already frozen mutable slots. A missing prerequisite row or
// missing material yields no proposed remediation; no negative heuristic exists.
func hybridGapReorder(s HybridPlanningSnapshot, in HybridConsequenceInputs, mastery map[string]HybridSnapshotMastery, items []HybridSnapshotItem, skipped map[string]bool) []HybridFutureMutation {
	if !in.Graph.Available || in.Graph.GoalCode != s.Path.GoalCode {
		return nil
	}
	graph := map[string][]HybridTargetRef{}
	for _, r := range in.Graph.Targets {
		graph[hybridTargetIdentity(r.Ref)] = r.Prerequisites
	}
	remaining := []HybridSnapshotItem{}
	for _, i := range items {
		if !skipped[i.ID] {
			remaining = append(remaining, i)
		}
	}
	if len(remaining) < 2 {
		return nil
	}
	edges := map[string]map[string]bool{}
	indegree := map[string]int{}
	providers := map[string][]string{}
	byID := map[string]HybridSnapshotItem{}
	for _, i := range remaining {
		edges[i.ID] = map[string]bool{}
		indegree[i.ID] = 0
		byID[i.ID] = i
		for _, t := range i.Targets {
			providers[hybridTargetIdentity(t)] = append(providers[hybridTargetIdentity(t)], i.ID)
		}
	}
	for _, i := range remaining {
		for _, t := range i.Targets {
			prereqs, ok := graph[hybridTargetIdentity(t)]
			if !ok {
				return nil
			}
			for _, p := range prereqs {
				k := hybridTargetIdentity(p)
				m, ok := mastery[k]
				if !ok {
					return nil
				}
				if m.State == MasteryMastered && m.Confidence >= in.Policy.MasterySkipConfidence {
					continue
				}
				source := providers[k]
				if len(source) != 1 || source[0] == i.ID {
					return nil
				}
				if !edges[source[0]][i.ID] {
					edges[source[0]][i.ID] = true
					indegree[i.ID]++
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ordered := []HybridSnapshotItem{}
	used := map[string]bool{}
	for len(ordered) < len(remaining) {
		candidate := ""
		for _, i := range remaining {
			if !used[i.ID] && indegree[i.ID] == 0 {
				candidate = i.ID
				break
			}
		}
		if candidate == "" {
			return nil
		}
		used[candidate] = true
		ordered = append(ordered, byID[candidate])
		for next := range edges[candidate] {
			indegree[next]--
		}
	}
	out := []HybridFutureMutation{}
	for i, item := range ordered {
		position := remaining[i].Position
		if position != item.Position {
			out = append(out, HybridFutureMutation{Kind: "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", ItemID: item.ID, TargetPosition: &position})
		}
	}
	return out
}

func validateHybridRequestedChange(s HybridPlanningSnapshot, p HybridLearningIntentProjection, in HybridConsequenceInputs, mastery map[string]HybridSnapshotMastery) error {
	baseline, _ := normalizeHybridScope(HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: s.Profile.DesiredStacks})
	desired := p.RequestedChange.Scope
	switch p.Kind {
	case "CHANGE_GOAL":
		if desired.GoalCode == baseline.GoalCode || desired.DirectionCode != baseline.DirectionCode || !reflect.DeepEqual(desired.DesiredStacks, baseline.DesiredStacks) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "CHANGE_DIRECTION":
		if desired.DirectionCode == baseline.DirectionCode || desired.GoalCode != baseline.GoalCode || !reflect.DeepEqual(desired.DesiredStacks, baseline.DesiredStacks) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "CHANGE_TECH_STACK":
		if reflect.DeepEqual(desired.DesiredStacks, baseline.DesiredStacks) || desired.GoalCode != baseline.GoalCode || desired.DirectionCode != baseline.DirectionCode {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "CHANGE_TRACK":
		return ErrValidation
	case "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT":
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(desired, baseline) || len(p.RequestedChange.Mutations) != 1 || p.RequestedChange.Mutations[0].Kind != p.Kind {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	items := map[string]HybridSnapshotItem{}
	for _, i := range s.Path.Items {
		items[i.ID] = i
	}
	protected := hybridProtectedItems(s)
	reservedIDs := map[string]bool{}
	for id := range items {
		reservedIDs[id] = true
	}
	desiredItemCount := len(s.Path.Items)
	positions := map[int]bool{}
	changedPositions := map[int]bool{}
	for _, m := range p.RequestedChange.Mutations {
		i, ok := items[m.ItemID]
		if !ok {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		switch m.Kind {
		case "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM", "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS", "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM", "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION":
			if protected[i.ID] || i.Status != LearningPathItemPlanned {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		default:
			if i.Status != LearningPathItemReady && i.Status != LearningPathItemInProgress {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			if p.Kind != m.Kind && p.Kind != "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE" {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
		if m.Kind == "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT" && !hybridActiveProject(s, i) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if m.Kind == "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS" {
			destinationFound := false
			for _, other := range s.Path.Items {
				if other.Position == *m.TargetPosition && !protected[other.ID] && other.Status == LearningPathItemPlanned {
					destinationFound = true
				}
			}
			if !destinationFound || positions[*m.TargetPosition] || *m.TargetPosition == i.Position {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			positions[*m.TargetPosition] = true
			changedPositions[i.Position] = true
		}
		if m.TemplateItemID != "" {
			template, ok := items[m.TemplateItemID]
			if !ok || !hybridFrozenTemplate(s, template) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			if m.Kind == "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM" && !reflect.DeepEqual(sortHybridTargetRefs(template.Targets), sortHybridTargetRefs(i.Targets)) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			if m.Kind == "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION" {
				if reservedIDs[m.NewItemID] || !in.Graph.Available || in.Graph.GoalCode != s.Path.GoalCode || len(template.Targets) == 0 || *m.TargetPosition < i.Position || *m.TargetPosition > len(s.Path.Items) || len(s.Path.Items) >= 500 {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				reservedIDs[m.NewItemID] = true
				desiredItemCount++
				if desiredItemCount > 500 {
					return ErrValidation
				}
				gap := false
				acceptedTargets := map[string]bool{}
				for _, row := range in.Graph.Targets {
					acceptedTargets[hybridTargetIdentity(row.Ref)] = true
				}
				for _, target := range template.Targets {
					if !acceptedTargets[hybridTargetIdentity(target)] {
						return ErrValidation
					}
					m, ok := mastery[hybridTargetIdentity(target)]
					if !ok {
						return ErrValidation
					}
					if m.State != MasteryMastered || m.Confidence < in.Policy.MasterySkipConfidence {
						gap = true
					}
				}
				if !gap {
					return ErrValidation
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(positions, changedPositions) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func hybridActiveProject(s HybridPlanningSnapshot, item HybridSnapshotItem) bool {
	for _, binding := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if binding.SurfaceClassification == "project" && (binding.LifecycleStatus == "OPEN" || binding.LifecycleStatus == "RESERVED") && (binding.LearningPathItemID == item.ID || (binding.LearningPathItemID == "" && item.ReferenceType == "practice" && binding.TaskRevisionID == item.ReferenceID)) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hybridFrozenTemplate(s HybridPlanningSnapshot, item HybridSnapshotItem) bool {
	if item.ReferenceType == "lesson" {
		return item.LessonRevisionID != "" && len(item.FrozenRequirements) > 0 && validateHybridLessonAssignment(item) == nil
	}
	if item.ReferenceType == "practice" {
		for _, binding := range s.PracticeBindings {
			if binding.TaskRevisionID == item.ReferenceID && hybridDigest(binding.TaskRevisionDigest) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

func ValidateHybridConsequence(c HybridConsequence) error {
	if c.Schema != HybridConsequenceSchema || !hybridUUID(c.StudentID) || !hybridUUID(c.LearningPathID) || c.ExpectedPathRevision < 1 || !hybridDigest(c.SnapshotRef) || c.PolicyVersion != HybridReplanPolicyVersion || !hybridDigest(c.PolicyInputHash) || c.ConsequenceID != HybridConsequenceID(c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID, c.SnapshotRef, c.PolicyVersion) || c.Mutations == nil || len(c.Mutations) > 500 || c.ReasonCodes == nil || len(c.ReasonCodes) == 0 || len(c.SnapshotTargets) == 0 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	request, err := NormalizeHybridSnapshotRequest(HybridSnapshotRequest{Targets: c.SnapshotTargets, TriggerContext: HybridSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "consequence", Reason: "immutable result"}})
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(request.Targets, c.SnapshotTargets) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	baseline, err := normalizeHybridScope(c.BaselineScope)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(baseline, c.BaselineScope) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	desired, err := normalizeHybridScope(c.DesiredScope)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(desired, c.DesiredScope) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	for i, r := range c.ReasonCodes {
		if !hybridReasons[r] || (i > 0 && r <= c.ReasonCodes[i-1]) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	newIDs := map[string]bool{}
	existingIDs := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range c.Mutations {
		existingIDs[m.ItemID] = true
	}
	for _, m := range c.Mutations {
		if m.NewItemID != "" {
			if newIDs[m.NewItemID] || existingIDs[m.NewItemID] {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			newIDs[m.NewItemID] = true
		}
	}
	previous := ""
	for _, m := range c.Mutations {
		if validateHybridMutation(m) != nil || m.ItemID <= previous {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		previous = m.ItemID
	}
	switch c.Outcome {
	case HybridOutcomeNoChange:
		if c.ApplicationMode != "" || len(c.Mutations) != 0 || c.IntentID != "" || c.RequiredIntentKind != "" || !reflect.DeepEqual(c.BaselineScope, c.DesiredScope) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded:
		switch c.ApplicationMode {
		case HybridApplicationAuto:
			if len(c.Mutations) == 0 || c.IntentID != "" || c.RequiredIntentKind != "" || !reflect.DeepEqual(c.BaselineScope, c.DesiredScope) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			for _, m := range c.Mutations {
				if m.Kind != "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM" && m.Kind != "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS" && m.Kind != "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM" && m.Kind != "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION" {
					return ErrValidation
				}
			}
		case HybridApplicationRequiresIntent:
			if !hybridUUID(c.IntentID) || !hybridIntentKinds[c.RequiredIntentKind] || (len(c.Mutations) == 0 && reflect.DeepEqual(c.BaselineScope, c.DesiredScope)) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		default:
			return ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func HybridConsequencePayloadHash(c HybridConsequence) (string, error) {
	if ValidateHybridConsequence(c) != nil {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	return hybridSnapshotDigest(c)
}
